## Review findings and skipped checks

State actual build, tests, lint, applicable security/accessibility checks and walkthrough
results. Missing, stale or not executed evidence is Unverified. Link findings and owners.

## Release blockers

Include pending gates, questions, assumptions, Proposed targets, readiness gaps,
Unverified required checks, blocking findings and expired exceptions.

## Recommendation

Approve / Approve with conditions / Request changes / Reject / Escalate.
Give evidence-linked reasons, conditions, limitations and next actions.
Recommendation is not approval; insufficient evidence requires Escalate.
